newsitem.title: LEBANON: Hizbollah, Israeli-allied militia to swap dead.
newsitem.headline: Hizbollah, Israeli-allied militia to swap dead.

text.p: Lebanon's Hizbollah and Israel's client South Lebanon Army (SLA) militia will swap on Friday the remains of two militiamen for two dead guerrillas, sources with the militant group said on Thursday.

Hizbollah (Party of God) said in a statement that it will hand over the bodies of two SLA fighters it holds to officials of the International Committee of the Red Cross at its press centre in Beirut's southern suburbs at 9.00 a.m. (0700 GMT).

Hizbollah sources said that in exchange the group would receive the bodies of two Hizbollah guerrillas from the SLA at one of four checkpoints linking Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone to the rest of the region.
There was no immediate confirmation of the report from the SLA.

The pro-Iranian Hizbollah leads a guerrilla war on some 1,000 Israeli troops and the 3,000-strong SLA in a bid to drive them from the south Lebanon border zone set up to protect northern Israel from cross-frontier guerrilla raids.

In July, Hizbollah and Israel exchanged the remains of two Israeli soldiers held by the group since 1986 for the bodies of 123 guerrillas under a German-brokered deal which also secured the release of 45 captives imprisoned by the SLA and the return of 17 SLA militiamen held captive by Hizbollah.
